newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in dull trading.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended mostly steady at 42.5400/5440 to the dollar in a dull interbank trading against the previous close of 42.5400/5450, dealers said on Sunday.
The taka stayed at Saturday's closing level in early trade but edged up marginally later with dollar demand remaining poor because of weekend closure of major overseas markets.
"Supply (of dollars) shrank today after a major dollar selling bank stayed out of the market. But poor buying helped the taka to retain its position," a dealer said.
Interbank call money rates finished unchanged at 5.0 to 5.5 percent, dealers said. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
